testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for a sketch under an extrusion: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:495:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for a sketch under an extrusion ✔ Given a part with an extrusion and its underlying dimensioned sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the sketch child in the browser ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the sketch row ✔ And the menu offers Edit Sketch, Redefine, Share Sketch and Properties ✔ And it offers Measure, Visibility and Export Sketch As ✔ And the sketch row is highlighted ✔ And the sketch geometry and dimensions are highlighted over the solid ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the sketch row, geometry and dimensions remain highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the empty viewport area again ✔ Then the sketch row is no longer highlighted ✔ And the highlighted sketch geometry and dimensions disappear from the viewport ✔ And the solid remains visible
